author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: ये ते कृपणाः कृपाविषयाः । तमः प्राप्तिमन्त इत्यर्थः
translation: V. The latter half bears another versjon. When it is said that knowledge is superior to Karma, the mistake may be made that, on the dawn of wisdom, one has nothing else to look to. To remove this error the latter half states : Ivon when knowledge has shone, look up to the Protector: for the dispenser of fruits is the Lord alone, and pitiable are those that think themselves the masters of the fruit of their action.(49.)
